metaTitle: Free Twitch Bot Pricing and Premium | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Compare Free, Premium and Enterprise. Finished features are free; Premium adds priority handling and access to beta modules.
donateTitle: Donations keep the free plan free.
donateText: Every channel, free or Premium, runs on the same servers. Premium and donations are what pay for them, so a Ko-fi donation keeps the bot online for everyone.
